items.html: And then, on the sixth day, ZON coupled in the aspect of back to back, and Adam HaRishon was created in this aspect alone. And had the first man not sinned, he would have awakened MAN on that first Shabbat, and through this ZON would have coupled face to face, in the more exalted aspect of all — that they would both use one crown, face to face, than which there is no greater growth; and she would receive from the upper Ima, not through him.
